Posted November 13, 2007 

Importuning by Richard Cowan  

 

This morning I found that two of my favorite websites were doing their periodic fund raising appeals. Their example gave me the courage or gumption to overcome my own reticence and do likewise. 

 

The fact is that rebuilding MarijuanaNews.com takes a lot of time, and time really takes money.  

 

As the headline says, Google recently turned down MarijuanaNews.coms application to carry AdSense, because it is about an illegal drug. I replied to no avail that it is really about the right to use a currently illegal drug, but I also had to remember that one of my proudest accomplishments is My version of Because I got high. By Richard Cowan 

"My purpose is to bring to others the freedom that God has given me. And so long as I can, that is what I will do, Because I got high."  

 

So maybe they are right.

 

And that is their right, even though they have accepted some websites that really surprise me. Of course, I could not tell them that. My no snitching policy has to extend to Google, the real power in this world! 

 

In any case, Google ads like any others really need traffic to make a website economically viable and politically effective. So, I am working on a number of substantive projects that will rebuild traffic for MarijuanaNews.com.  

 

I will be taking a much more aggressive stance against prohibitionist propaganda in the old media and the new. I believe in the power of ideas, and ideas have more power when they are heard by more people, but they do not have tongues of their own.  

 

The Declaration of Independence begins its indictment by saying, we hold these truths to be self-evident, but they did not just write them down and then go home and wait for the King to apologize. It would not have happened even if they had started a blog, which Benjamin Franklin would have loved.  

 

Of course, I am not going to try to start a Revolution, because I am not only committed to non-violence, the non-violence of freedom and the freedom of non-violence is the real message of MarijuanaNews.com. 

See
The Theory and Practice of Chaos  Analysis By Richard Cowan  

 

Speaking truth to power has a power of its own. 

 

The anthropologist Margaret Read is often quoted: Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world. Indeed, it is the only thing that ever has.

 

It would not be blowing smoke of any kind at you to say that the simple fact that you are reading this page makes you part of such a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens who can change the world.  

 

In the meantime, there is the mundane fact that the bills go on. 

 

I hate asking for your financial support, but. I have to overcome my embarrassment and rattle my tin cup again.  If you find that MarijuanaNews is valuable to you, I hope that you can find a way to help cover the costs.  

 

The vulgar details: The easiest and quickest way to make a contribution would be to click on the Paypal button on the top left of the page. 

If you have any questions or want to make other arrangements, you can email me cowan@MarijuanaNews.com   

 

I would like to hear from you, anyway. 

 

Many thanks,
Richard Cowan  

A short history of MarijuanaNews.com  

 

 

In the  Users Guide to MarijuanaNews.com How To Find What You Need To Know.  I noted that that MarijuanaNews.com was founded ten years ago this month.  

 

It began on a dial up connection, which seems Neolithic now. I had previously set up MarijuanaMagazine.com (no longer the same site) for the late Peter McWilliams.

See
Author Handcuffed as the DEA Searches Home After He Runs Variety Ad Critical of DEA.
and
The Murder of Peter McWilliams -- An Indictment, Not an Obituary by Richard Cowan  

Nonetheless, I really did not have any idea what I was getting into. Perhaps I still do not. I wrote on my bio page, now out of date, that MarijuanaNews.com was to be by me, not about me. Eventually, it would become a part of me. 

 

At first, I got very busy trying to gather as many news stories as possible to document both the current history of marijuana prohibition and also the media bias that created and perpetuates it.

See how little some things have changed Washington Post Launches New Prohibitionist Propaganda Campaign (Two Long Articles)  
(From November of 1997. The Post's links are dead, but the problem is clear.)

 

Fortunately, Mapinc.org began about the same time, and when its archives began to exceed mine, I decided to concentrate on other things, and ended up in Canada, which was very pleasant at first.

It was easy to find things to write about as the Drug Czar targeted Canada and BC Bud, distracting attention from the real action at the other border, with plenty of help from the media.

See
RCMP Report On The Drug Situation in Canada 2004 Contradicts The Prohibitionist Party Line Again. Mexico Supplies US With At Least 25 Times More Than Canada. Ontario Rivals British Columbia .
and
How The Canadian Media Import Counterfeit News From The States. The Drug Czar Lies and Even The Best Papers Dont Check the Facts.
and
Front Page Fantasy: The New York Times Pushes Fact Free Journalism Supposedly About BC Bud
and
Time Magazine Reports BC Bud 20% Less Potent Than Four Years Ago??  Incompetent Prohibitionist Propaganda and Even Worse Journalism. As Some Reporters Die to Find the Truth Others Live to Lie. 
 

I really wanted to be able to devote my time to analytical writing. However, I inevitably found myself personally involved as my friends fought for their lives.

See
Steve Tuck Is A Free Man. Vindicated. Recuperating from Five Year Ordeal. Will Return to Mining Business in Canada After First Of Year.
and
Program Notes for the MarijuanaNews Global Conspiracy Report August 3, 2005 US Fails To Get  Marc Held Without Bail. Mexico The Real Problem. Kubby Zings Czar. Interview with Michelle Rainey. 

I think I helped delay injustice for a while, but I found that while there is complete freedom to express abstract truth in Canada, pointing out real injustices wears out ones welcome.  

So, for now, I am back in America, rebuilding MarijuanaNews.com  with your help.
